free_tier_limits: Select models can be run free for limited usage; Replicate eventually requires billing setup, and no fixed free-credit amount is promised.
rate_limits: Default: 600 prediction-creation requests/minute and 3,000 requests/minute for other endpoints; accounts with low/granted credit and no payment method may get stricter limits.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: auditor correct — docs describe free limited use of select models, not a fixed signup credit (https://replicate.com/pricing, https://replicate.com/docs). rate_limits: auditor correct — Replicate publishes defaults of 600 prediction creates/min and 3,000 other requests/min, with stricter limits possible without payment method (https://replicate.com/docs/topics/rate-limits or /docs/reference/http).
